Patricia — thanks, and congrats on the pilot approval. High level we can support the uplift with a staged approach that preserves predictable unit economics while giving MediScale runway for Q4. I've attached a short proposal and the pricing_model we discussed.

Options (summary):

Option A — Staged uplift (recommended)
- Commit to +35% baseline uplift for 9 months; co-term to 2027-04-01.
- Discount: 8% blended discount on token rate for the uplift tranche (applied to committed uplift volume).
- Surge months above committed uplift billed at on-demand rate, capped at +15% over committed per-month spend.
- Includes 10k monthly support credits (priority queue) for migration assistance.

Option B — Short-term burst credit + no co-term change
- No contractual co-term change; reserve burst capacity credits for Q4 at a 5% discount when pre-purchased.
- Simpler procurement but less favorable unit rate.

Option C — Annualize early (higher commitment)
- Annualize uplift into a 12-month added committed SKU; 12% discount but requires procurement approval for full term.

Operational notes:
- We can include a limited rollback clause: if actual uplift falls below 70% of committed uplift across the 9-month period, we automatically step down to Option B rates for the remainder (helps MediScale avoid overpaying).
- SOC2: attached SOC2_summary_redacted.pdf; full kit can be sent to your security SFTP under an NDA.

Next steps I propose:
1) You indicate preferred option (A/B/C) by Fri Aug 20.
2) We will prepare a clean amendment + DocuSign (if co-term/amendment) and a 1-page MOP (mutual action plan) for procurement + PM alignment.

Attaching: MediScale_Proposal_v3.pdf, pricing_model.xlsx, SOC2_summary_redacted.pdf

Cheers,
